subject: The Uber driver who fixed my EQ
preview_text: A car full of passengers, a quiet phone, and a trick I never expected to share.
body_paragraphs: A few weeks ago, a user emailed me a story. He was driving for Uber, had three passengers in the back, and needed to hear his podcast over road noise. He couldn't crank the phone speaker—he'd wake the whole car. So he did something I never saw coming.

He opened Loud EQ, tapped Optimize, and held his phone speaker toward the backseat. The app calibrated around the car cabin—not headphones. Suddenly, dialogue cut through wind and engine hum like he was in a studio. His passengers didn't even notice. He just heard everything.

I built Loud EQ for headphones and earbuds. Never thought anyone would use it for a car speaker or a quiet room. But the same trick works: open the app, pick the Podcast profile, and hit Optimize. It tunes the boost around the air around you—not just your ears.

Try it right now. Open Loud EQ, choose Podcast, and tap that Optimize button. You'll hear the difference in seconds. P.S. This works for speakerphone calls too—no more asking people to repeat themselves.
